Define an Event Process for sim_model()

Source: R/sim-model.R
sim_process.Rd

sim_process builds an event process whose baseline intensity is Weibull, $$\lambda_0(t) = \eta \nu t^{\nu - 1},$$ i.e. cumulative baseline hazard \(\eta t^\nu\), or follows a given cumulative baseline hazard curve (cumhaz). sim_effect()s into the process multiply this baseline by \(\exp(\text{coef} \times \text{from})\).

Usage

sim_process(
  type = c("censoring", "terminal", "transient"),
  eta,
  nu,
  limit = Inf,
  cumhaz = NULL
)

Arguments

type

One of:

"censoring"

Ends follow-up without an outcome event.

"terminal"

An outcome event ending follow-up (e.g. death).

"transient"

An event that doesn't end follow-up and can recur (e.g. relapse).

eta

Numeric. Weibull scale parameter.

nu

Numeric. Weibull shape parameter: nu > 1 gives an increasing hazard, nu < 1 a decreasing one, nu = 1 a constant one.

limit

Integer or Inf. Maximum number of events of a "transient" process. Default Inf.

cumhaz

Optional data.frame with columns time and hazard giving the cumulative baseline hazard, e.g. from survival::basehaz() with centered = FALSE. Used instead of eta and nu, and interpolated linearly. The hazard is unknown after the last time, so sim_events() ends follow-up there, as for max_cens.

Value

An object of class sim_process, for use in sim_model().

See also

sim_model(), sim_covariate()

Examples

# Death, with a slowly increasing hazard:
sim_process("terminal", eta = 0.1, nu = 1.1)
#> $type
#> [1] "terminal"
#> 
#> $eta
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $nu
#> [1] 1.1
#> 
#> $limit
#> [1] Inf
#> 
#> $cumhaz
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "sim_process"

# A relapse process that can fire at most twice:
sim_process("transient", eta = 0.2, nu = 1, limit = 2)
#> $type
#> [1] "transient"
#> 
#> $eta
#> [1] 0.2
#> 
#> $nu
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $limit
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $cumhaz
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "sim_process"

# A hazard that is high early on and low later:
sim_process(
  "terminal",
  cumhaz = data.frame(time = c(1, 5), hazard = c(0.5, 0.7))
)
#> $type
#> [1] "terminal"
#> 
#> $eta
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $nu
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $limit
#> [1] Inf
#> 
#> $cumhaz
#>   time hazard
#> 1    1    0.5
#> 2    5    0.7
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "sim_process"
